name: Frame.io
mood: Midnight cinema projection room with near-black cosmic gradients, one blue spotlight, violet product halos, and restrained editorial product chrome.

carbonVellum.role: Primary text, inverse button text, icon strokes, and paper-like contrast against the void.

obsidian.role: Primary page canvas and dominant background with blue undertone.

pitch.role: Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not use as the full-page background alone.

void.role: Secondary canvas layer and top nav background.

graphite.role: Card surface for elevated product mockups.

ash.role: Tertiary text, card descriptions, inactive nav, muted foreground.

charcoal.role: Hairline divider and subtle card border.

irisGlow.role: Sole chromatic accent for icons, eyebrow labels, links, active states, and feature marks.

twilight.role: Muted violet for product-frame borders, glow halos, and atmospheric tints.

specterLilac.role: Soft highlight on violet accents and light-mode card edges.

surfaces.name: Cosmic Canvas
surfaces.purpose: Primary page background with deep purple/blue gradient overlay.

surfaces.name: Nav Veil
surfaces.purpose: Slightly darker top layer behind navigation.

surfaces.name: Product Surface
surfaces.purpose: Embedded app UI mockups and product chrome.

surfaces.name: Card Halo
surfaces.purpose: Inset violet depth for card frames.

do: Use 100px border radius for buttons, nav items, and pills.
Set display headlines at weight 400 with tight negative letter spacing.
Reserve Iris Glow for icons, eyebrow labels, links, and active states.
Place the NeueMachinaInktrap eyebrow label above every major section headline.
Layer at least one gradient on every page background.
Set max content width to 1280px and keep backgrounds full bleed.
Use FrameGothic at 14px to 18px for body and feature text in Smoke or Ash.
Frame product imagery in 10px-radius containers with a 1px Twilight border.
dont: Do not use weight 600 or 700 for display headlines.
Do not introduce additional accent colors.
Do not use flat black as a full-page background.
Do not add card backgrounds or heavy borders to feature columns.
Do not use serif fonts or decorative typefaces.
Do not add drop shadows to buttons or nav items.
Do not use the eyebrow label style for anything except section identifiers.
